box.text: Note that the getid message to live.remote~ and live.modulate~ may report ids that are no longer available. They are only guaranteed to be correct on load, in other situations the monitored id is correct.
Prevent storing an invalid mapping in a set. Note: we can't defer this; that would cause an additional undo
We don't need to send a mapped id update to remote~ or modulate~ (they manage that themselves) but we do want to communicate it outward and store it for when we switch mapping mode.
Note there is currently a known bug that live.thisdevice outputs a bang when undoing adding this device as part of a preset.
Undoing the mode setting currently results in an error because it causes a change of ids. To fix the error, we should deferlow it, but that would create an extra undo every time we toggle the button.
We don't need to pass on id 0 when it comes from a getid request because that happens only on load and it would cause an extra undo step on load.
The id we try to map
Updates us when undoing a mapping or when the mapped parameter disappears.
`mapped` is output after (an attempt at) mapping a non-0 id or when undoing a failed map attempt. We need to make sure the latter doesn't cause an undo.
Parameter values are always output before live.thisdevice fires.
Prevent outputting the stored id on init when duplicating the device. We don't need this since we can only map to a parameter once.
Prevent passing through when setting the value
We can't set the 'id' property as an argument because that creates an undo on load. Also we only want to start monitoring  after we changed something.

Persistent mapping needs to be on to track undo and redo. 

Also keeps track of id changes of the parameter. Outputs id 0 when param disappears and old id when it re-appears, i.e after undo.

Also outputs the stored id when duplicating the device.
Note: when updating this patch, don't forget to update  Abl.MapWithScaledOuput.maxpat
If not mapped, mute the patch to save CPU.
Make depth offset negative for unipolar input.
If input and output polarities don't match, offset by 0.5 * depth.
If output is bipolar, multiply output by 2, otherwise by 1
If input is bipolar, subtract 0.5 from input.

Input    | Output
         |
         | Unipolar                         Bipolar
         |--------------------------------------------------------
Unipolar | out = in                         out = in - 0.5 * depth
Bipolar  | out = in - 0.5 + 0.5 * depth     out = in - 0.5
Turn off the map button when parameter was successfully mapped.
When Map is turned on, the next Live parameter clicked on will be selected as a target and the menus will be modified accordingly.
When enabling a Map button, make sure to turn all others off.

box.comment: (lom id) selected parameter if not self
(bang) waiting for new mapping has stopped
